entry.title: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
entry.summary: Saudi authorities say the latest attack on the international airport in the capital, Riyadh, has killed 12 people and injured over 300. Their statement says the dead on Saturday included four Saudi citizens as well as two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese. It said some of those injured were in critical condition. The attack — the latest of several in the past week on King Khalid International Airport — is expected to increase Saudi pressure on allies including the United States to provide military support for the kingdom.

entry.title: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
entry.summary: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.

entry.title: Trump weighs joining the fight against Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
entry.summary: The surge in attacks, including against other Saudi airports, military facilities and oil infrastructure, has come in the week since a Saudi-led coalition launched a major military offensive against the Houthis.

entry.title: Protests against voter roll revisions rock capital of world's largest democracy
entry.summary: Parts of the capital city of India, the world's largest democracy, are on lockdown. Protests over sweeping revisions to the voter rolls were met with a massive police crackdown.

entry.title: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
entry.summary: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.

entry.title: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
entry.summary: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

entry.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
entry.summary: The protests focus on the Election Commission's voter list revision, which the opposition claims disenfranchises millions. The government denies the allegations, saying the revision aims to eliminate duplicate entries.

entry.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
entry.summary: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.

entry.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
entry.summary: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

entry.title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
entry.summary: A global treaty signed by 197 countries — including Russia — requires reporting any death that could be a sign of an outbreak to come.
